newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.79 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.79 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 70 billion dong ($6.00 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.79 percent to two domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on June 4, the central bank sold 70 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.9 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is June 13 and maturity will be on June 13, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 60.0 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 10.0 billion
